title: Psychotherapist visit
what: A doctor who treats anxiety, depression, and other conditions with talking methods. If needed, they can prescribe medicines.
why: For anxiety, panic attacks, low mood, insomnia, obsessive thoughts, and the effects of trauma and stress.
duration: usually 45 to 60 minutes; you decide on the course together with the doctor
tell_doctor: What bothers you, and for how long
What medicines and substances you take, including alcohol

prepare.title: Your goal
prepare.text: Write down what bothers you and what you expect from treatment.

prepare.title: Place
prepare.text: For an online session, find a quiet place where no one can overhear you.

bring: Past test results, discharge papers, and reports
A list of your medicines, or the packs themselves
steps: The doctor asks about your concerns and your life
They explain which method may suit you
You agree on a session schedule
If needed, the doctor prescribes medicines
feel: It is a conversation, with no procedures
Talking about personal things can be hard. You can take pauses
after: Do the tasks between sessions, if you are given any
Do not stop medicines on your own. Ask the doctor
red_flags: Thoughts of harming yourself: do not wait for the visit. Call emergency services

faq.q: How is a psychotherapist different from a psychologist?
faq.a: Here, a psychotherapist is a doctor who can prescribe medicines. A psychologist works only through talking.
A course can last from a few weeks to a year or more. Discuss the timing with your doctor.

reminders.text: Psychotherapist visit tomorrow. Write down what bothers you, and bring your medicine list.
